pages.text: Run an action subtree using each selected living target's position and chosen orientation, creating target-centered secondary spells.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Add the action costs for each selected living target.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1 plus the action structure once, without multiplying by targets.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).
